meta.description: Every coil's position, mapped the moment it's placed.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Steel coils stacked in pyramid formations across a yard are hard to track by memory, and manually recording hundreds of daily moves is slow and error-prone.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Fixed cameras detect slot occupancy per section as cranes place coils, the operator confirms the coil ID, and a digital yard model updates in real time for every authorized user.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Instant, reliable coil lookup instead of retrieval that used to eat significant yard time.
